description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.034 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. US federal contract and grant intelligence for any company via USASpending.gov. Returns total obligated amount, award count, top awards (award ID, amount, agency, description, start date), and agency breakdown — covering $10T+ in federal spending. Useful for procurement research, competitive intelligence, vendor due diligence, and government contractor analysis. No API key required.
